blocks.value: This certificate is hereby awarded to

Confirming successful demonstration of competency in the safe preparation, 
administration, and documentation of medications in accordance with professional 
standards, regulatory frameworks, and evidence-based clinical practice guidelines.
Aged Care and Community Health Services
Comprehensive medication safety principles and error prevention strategies
The holder has achieved competency in the following domains:
Application of the Seven Rights of Medication Administration
Accurate dosage calculation, measurement, and verification procedures
Competent administration via all approved routes (oral, topical, subcutaneous, intramuscular)
Proper medication storage, handling, and security protocols

This certificate requires renewal biennially and 
is subject to ongoing competency verification.

Issued on: November 25, 2026
Valid Until: November 25, 2029
